targets.default_protocol_note: protocol_mode is the fair-baseline default (community H1 loopback). H2C / H2-over-TLS are reached via the run-guided protocol+TLS override axis, not via a separate target_id. The saga (h2c) launch contract is runtime/drivers/env/exeris-e2e-runtime.env, selected by the saga runner.

targets.descriptor: Spring Boot + Hibernate ORM (JVM, virtual threads)
targets.default_protocol_note: protocol_mode is the fair-baseline default (community H1 loopback). H2C is reached via the run-guided protocol override (the legacy spring-app-axon saga label was the same jar/env at h2c). Persistence layer = Hibernate ORM.

targets.descriptor: Spring on Exeris (compatibility mode + Exeris Flow)
targets.eligibility_note: Baseline-candidate for request-path endpoints only. The compat request-scope bug was resolved by exeris-spring-runtime-web #48 (request-path DB access serves 2xx; verified in results/raw/guided/20260610T160359Z). Saga terminal-state metrics are NOT eligible: flow steps run on kernel worker VTs outside the request-scoped compat provider binding, so the saga never resolves (saga_success_rate=0, threshold_failure). This target is excluded from scenarios/e2e-shop-order-saga/comparative-pair-manifest.json and flagged baseline-only in tools/verify-target-asset-matrix.sh. See targets/exeris-spring-runtime-app-comp/README.md section 'Runtime eligibility'.

targets.default_protocol_note: protocol_mode is the fair-baseline default (community H1 loopback); health_url is cleartext h1 (fair baseline: same cleartext posture as exeris-community/spring-hibernate). H2C is reached via the run-guided protocol override (the legacy quarkus-app-axon saga label was the same jar/env at h2c). Persistence layer = Hibernate ORM.

targets.descriptor: Quarkus + pure JDBC, no ORM, tuned transport: native epoll + native BoringSSL TLS (JVM, virtual threads)
targets.eligibility_note: Tuned-transport (native epoll + native BoringSSL TLS) pure-JDBC Quarkus; contrast with quarkus-hibernate which runs default Quarkus (JDK NIO + JSSE). Pure-JDBC also isolates Hibernate ORM cost (same SQL shapes, no ORM mapping layer). App is in flight (targets/quarkus-benchmark-app-tuned); not yet wired into a comparative-pair-manifest as comparison_eligible. Promote to scenarios/entity-read-by-id/comparative-pair-manifest.json (paired quarkus-hibernate__quarkus-tuned, within-tier H1) once the app + fixed contract land. Flagged justified-unused in tools/verify-target-asset-matrix.sh until then.

targets.descriptor: Restate durable-execution saga (JVM SDK 2.9, virtual threads) + pure JDBC
targets.default_protocol_note: protocol_mode h1 is the fair-baseline declaration: the k6-facing facade (JDK com.sun.net.httpserver) speaks HTTP/1.1 only — an h1-vs-h2c protocol mismatch against the canonical saga contracts and therefore a strict-gate disqualifier, same class as spring-on-exeris. Deployment unit is this JVM (facade :9004 + Restate SDK endpoint :9084) plus an external restate-server (ingress :8080, admin :9070) started by the saga baseline as compose service benchmark-restate-server.
targets.eligibility_note: Saga-only target (e2e-shop-order-saga CONTRACT-v2; v2 request-response model — terminal outcome in the POST /api/v1/orders 200 body, status polling served but normally skipped by k6). Not yet referenced by any comparative-pair-manifest or scenario.json fixed_contract; wire both (plus tools/verify-target-asset-matrix.sh) before any comparative claim. Like the Axon stacks, part of the deployment unit (restate-server container exeris-e2e-saga-restate-server) runs outside the per-process resource sampler — whole-deployment footprint claims must attribute it separately (logs/restate-server-docker-stats.csv). Durability tier: restate-server 1.7 default is T2 fsync node-durable (RocksDB WAL fsync per commit batch); cross-tier comparisons forbidden per CONTRACT-v2 s8.
